name: prcompRob
title: Robust Principal Components Cont'd
description:
This function uses the pcaRobS function to compute all principal components while
behaving similarly to the prcomp function

arguments.description: data matrix with observations in rows
Maximal number of principal components to be used (optional)

value.description: the standard deviation of the principal components

examples_r:
data(wine)

p.wine <- prcompRob(wine)
summary(p.wine)

## Choose only 5
p5.wine <- prcompRob(wine, rank. = 5)
summary(p5.wine)
